It is primarily [[Foraging]], [[Hunting]], and [[Fishing]]-oriented location, with a variety of unique features resolving around progress in those skills. It can be accessed from the {{Zone|Jungle Island}} of {{Zone|The Park}} after reaching {{Skill|Foraging|12}}. == Features == The '''Moonglade Marsh''' is a [[Foraging]], [[Hunting]], and [[Fishing]]-oriented location, with a variety of unique features resolving around progress in those skills. When joining the island, the player can first speak to {{NPCSprite|Hina}} to unlock the {{Item|Heart of the Forest}}, which grants perks that buff {{Skill|Foraging}}. The island contains Fig Trees and Mangrove Trees, as well as unique [[#Foraging Mechanics|mechanics]] for those trees. These can be harvested in exchange for [[#Foraging Mechanics|Tree Gifts]], which are granted to players who helped break the tree. Players can speak to {{NPCSprite|David Hunterborough}} to learn about [[Hunting]] through his [[#Hunting Quest|Quest]]. The island contains various [[#Critters|Critters]], which can be hunted in exchange for [[Attribute Shards]]. The {{Item|Heart of the Forest}} also grants Hunting-related perks. The island also features large bodies of water, which can be swam in or used for [[Fishing]] for exclusive [[#Items|Items]] or [[#Sea Creatures|Sea Creatures]]. === Chapters === The '''Moonglade Marsh''' contains [[Chapters]], which consist of {{Yellow|69}} tasks for the player to complete in exchange for rewards. These chapters can be accessed by speaking to {{NPCSprite|Hina}}. {{:Chapters/Moonglade Marsh}} === Heart of the Forest === The {{Item|Heart of the Forest}} is a [[Skill Tree]] that grants various perks related to {{Skill|Foraging}} and {{Skill|Hunting}} that is unlocked by speaking to {{NPCSprite|Hina}} at {{Zone|Tangleburg's Path}}. One can obtain {{HotF EXP}} through [[Tree Gift]]s and [[Agatha|Agatha Contests]], and leveling up the [[Heart of the Forest|{{DarkGreen|Heart of the Forest}}]] or its {{DarkGreen|Center of the Forest}} perk grants [[Token of the Forest|{{DarkGreen|Tokens of the Forest}}]]. ===Foraging Mechanics=== The '''Moonglade Marsh''' contains Fig Trees and Mangrove Trees, which grant {{Item|Fig Log}}s and {{Item|Mangrove Log}}s respectively. These trees have {{Stat|Toughness}} which controls how much {{Stat|Sweep}} is required to cut them down. Having more {{Stat|Sweep}} allows the player to cut these trees down faster. These trees also have unique '''styles''', which dictate the order in which they must be cut down Failing to cut down a tree in the correct order results in a {{Red|50%}} {{Stat|Sweep}} reduction. Some Fig and Mangrove Trees have {{Red|Tree Protection Orders}} on them. These trees cannot be broken. Instead, the player can right-click them with {{Item|Fun-Sized Pot of Honeycomb|text=Fun-Sized}}, {{Item|Family-Sized Pot of Honeycomb|text=Family-Sized}}, {{Item|Jumbo Pot of Honeycomb|text=Jumbo}}, or {{Item|Behemoth Pot of Honeycomb}}. After waiting for a period of time based on the pot used, a random creature will spawn by the tree, depending on the type of tree. {| class="wikitable" ! Render ! Tree ! Location ! Toughness ! === Collections === The '''Moonglade Marsh''' allows the player to unlock specific new [[Collections]], including {{Item|Fig Log}}s, {{Item|Mangrove Log}}s, {{Item|Lushlilac}}s, {{Item|Sea Lumies}}, {{Item|Tender Wood}}, and {{Item|Vinesap}}. {{Item|Fig Log}}s and {{Item|Mangrove Log}}s are primarily obtained from cutting down trees. {{Item|Tender Wood}} and {{Item|Vinesap}} also have a chance to be obtained from [[Tree Gifts]] from breaking these. {{Item|Lushlilac}}s can be obtained from bushes scattered throughout the island that periodically grow berries. Harvesting a bush grants {{Item|Lushlilac|amount=1}}, {{Green|25}} {{Skill|Foraging}} XP, and {{Forest Whisper|100}}. Additionally, a {{MobSprite|Birries}} has a {{Green|10%}} chance to spawn. {{Item|Sea Lumies}} can be harvested from within the {{Zone|Murkwater Shallows}} and {{Zone|Murkwater Depths}}. |-|Fig Log = {{CollectionTable|Fig Log}} |-|Mangrove Log = {{CollectionTable|Mangrove Log}} |-|Lushlilac = {{CollectionTable|Lushlilac}} |-|Sea Lumies = {{CollectionTable|Sea Lumies}} |-|Tender Wood = {{CollectionTable|Tender Wood}} |-|Vinesap = {{CollectionTable|Vinesap}} === Hunting Quest === {{Main|Hunting|Attributes}} When players first join the '''Moonglade Marsh''', they are tasked with completing a quest that introduces them to [[Hunting]]. This involves speaking to {{NPCSprite|Swoop}}, {{NPCSprite|David Hunterborough}}, {{NPCSprite|Alan}}, {{NPCSprite|Oden}}, {{NPCSprite|Albert}}, {{NPCSprite|Jaeger}}, {{NPCSprite|Auryon}}, {{NPCSprite|Kysha}}, {{NPCSprite|Agatha}}, and {{NPCSprite|Dax}}. Throughout this quest, the player obtains a [[Fishing Nets|Fishing Net]], [[Lassos|Lasso]], [[Huntaxes|Huntaxe]], [[Pocket Black Hole]], and {{Item|David's Cloak}}. === Starlyn Contests === Within the center of the island in the {{Zone|Murkwater Loch}}, players can find and speak to {{NPCSprite|Agatha}} to learn about [[Agatha#Contests|Starlyn Contests]]. These are contests that occur every 20 minutes, where the player can earn points for [[Foraging]] and [[Hunting]] mobs, with more points granting better rewards. === Fishing Mechanics === Players can go [[Fishing]] on the '''Moonglade Marsh''' and catch items from a unique loot pool or unique [[Sea Creatures]]. ==== Items ==== {{:Treasure/Loot/Moonglade Marsh}} ====Sea Creatures ====
